text:
alex: Heads-up — after the RBAC refactor rollout this morning a subset of users are getting stuck in a login loop. They land in 'limited_viewer' and then SSO redirects back to the app.
karen-sec: :eyes: which change specifically? the role/permission rename or the JIT attr enforcement?
morgan: it was the JIT attr enforcement tweak (PR #5423) — we flipped `require_scoped_affiliation` to true for stricter least-privilege.
alex: sample SAML we pulled from one of the failing sessions — no `scopedAffiliation` attr present.
alex: ```
SAML Assertion excerpt:
<NameID>tjones@example.com</NameID>
<Attribute Name="roles">viewer</Attribute>
<!-- missing Attribute Name="scopedAffiliation" -->
```
nate-iam: KMS signing/decrypt looks fine; assertion signature verified. The issue is upstream Okta not emitting scopedAffiliation for some partner orgs.
sre-oncall: saw a spike in auth errors in Kibana around 09:04. Sentry shows redirect loop with 401 -> 302 -> 401.
devex: short-term mitigation — can we allow fallback mapping by domain when scopedAffiliation absent? e.g. if email domain == @partner.com -> map to `partner_viewer`.
morgan: yes, but that changes auth surface. I'd prefer a rollback of the JIT require flag, then run a reconciliation to attach roles for users missing the attr.
okta-bot: deploy log: revert config `jit_require_scoped_affiliation` queued by alex-deploy at 2758002500
alex: planning to rollback now. Will also add ad-hoc audit scan to find events where `role_source` is null.
alex: quick audit query I ran:
```
# pseudo
gcloud logging read 'resource.type="okta_app" AND jsonPayload.role_source=NULL' --limit 200
```
nate-iam: found ~118 affected users across 3 tenants. KMS logs show normal decrypts; audit payloads just missing the role_source field.
karen-sec: approved rollback. After rollback: run reconciliation job and add an alert for missing `role_source` on new SSO events. Also open an incident ticket and escalate to Okta support for partner tenants.
morgan: pushed a small script to fix roles for existing users: `scripts/reconcile_jit_roles.py --since 2757990000 --dry-run` (will run full job after revert).
okta-bot: deploy result: config `jit_require_scoped_affiliation` reverted at 2758002527 by alex-deploy — status: success
alex: rollback completed. Confirmed login loops resolved for sample users. Working on running the reconciliation now.
karen-sec: please file a short postmortem: impact, root cause (Okta attr omission + strict JIT flag), mitigation, and follow-ups (alerting + Okta ticket). Assign to morgan + alex, due EOD.
morgan: filing the incident now and will attach logs + `reconcile_jit_roles` runbook.
alex: note for follow-up — add explicit `role_source` in our mapping pipeline so audit trails never drop that field even if assertion attr missing.
devex: also let's document the rollback play in the Runbook under RBAC/SSO -> JIT attribute changes. :memo:
karen-sec: thanks all. closing the urgent channel once reconciliation job finishes successfully.
